input.content: Order the remaining items in BIRCH-WEST-requisition.json for Birch West. The installation schedule and compensation terms are in BIRCH-WEST-contract.json; the customer message is in BIRCH-WEST-customer.txt. Supplier quotes and the cost-centre budget are in the document service. Return the issued purchase-order references and a brief reconciliation.

input.name: bash
input.arguments: {"command":"cat /workspace/PLATFORM.md && printf '\\n--- requisition ---\\n' && cat /workspace/BIRCH-WEST-requisition.json && printf '\\n--- contract ---\\n' && cat /workspace/BIRCH-WEST-contract.json && printf '\\n--- customer ---\\n' && cat /workspace/BIRCH-WEST-customer.txt"}

input.output:

customer message are available through read_document. create_order prepares a
supplier order, approve_order submits it for approval, and issue_order places it.
cancel_order cancels an unissued order. order_status returns current order records.
delivery_status returns the contract schedule and current business time.

Python 3.12 is installed; working files are under /workspace. The project registry
is at /registry. Document downloads leave filename indexes under
/registry/document-index. Registry files remain available between jobs.

--- requisition ---
